correctness.rationale: Proposition 5.1 supplies the exact reciprocal quadratics with traces \(a_+(m)=2-3m^2-m^3\) and \(a_-(m)=a_+(-m)\). A reciprocal quadratic \(z^2-az+1\) has both roots on the unit circle exactly for \(|a|\le2\). Direct evaluation on \(m=-3,-2,-1,0,1\) plus monotone inequalities for \(m\ge2\) and \(m\le-4\) gives the exact exceptional set for \(a_+\); sign reversal gives the set for \(a_-\). For \(|m|\ge4\) both absolute traces are at least \(18\), so the exact spectral-radius formula gives the sharp lower bound \(9+4\sqrt5\), attained at \(m=\pm4\). Proposition 5.2 independently translates \(m\) to the stated trace criterion. No finite computation is used as the infinite proof.
